lines.text: Gemini, hot and cold is not a personality. It's a forecast nobody can plan around.
lines.caption: pick a temperature

lines.text: Gemini, talking for hours is not the same as saying something.
lines.caption: say something

lines.text: Gemini, if you're bored, say so. Don't just disappear.
lines.caption: don't vanish

lines.text: Gemini, they fell for one version of you. Show them the other one.
lines.caption: meet the other one

lines.text: Gemini, mixed signals are just a message you were scared to send.
lines.caption: send the message

lines.text: Gemini, the person who keeps up with your mind is rare. Don't test it.
lines.caption: don't test it

lines.text: Gemini, replying fast and showing up are two different skills.
lines.caption: show up

lines.text: Gemini, you get bored when it gets real. That's the part that matters.
lines.caption: the real part

lines.text: Gemini, you can love two ideas of someone. You can only date one person.
lines.caption: one person

lines.text: Gemini, a long voice note is not a commitment.
lines.caption: nice voice note though

lines.text: Gemini, stop keeping one foot out the door just in case.
lines.caption: both feet in

lines.text: Gemini, the chat is fun. The silence after is the real test.
lines.caption: after the chat

lines.text: Gemini, you went quiet the moment they asked a real question.
lines.caption: it was a real question

lines.text: Gemini, flirting with everyone means nobody gets to feel chosen.
lines.caption: choose someone

lines.text: Gemini, if you need a new face every month, the problem is not the faces.
lines.caption: not the faces

lines.text: Gemini, you don't owe anyone constant fun. You owe them honesty.
lines.caption: honesty over fun

lines.text: Gemini, say the thing you mean before the joke covers it.
lines.caption: no joke

lines.text: Gemini, being interesting is easy for you. Being consistent is the gift.
lines.caption: consistent is hot

lines.text: Gemini, being their favorite conversation is not the same as being their person.
lines.caption: more than a chat

lines.text: Gemini, you left read on the one who actually cared.
lines.caption: left on read

lines.text: Gemini, curiosity got you in the door. Staying needs something else.
lines.caption: stay a while

lines.text: Gemini, sometimes the deep talk is the adventure.
lines.caption: go deep

lines.text: Gemini, you don't have to pick a version of yourself to be loved.
lines.caption: all of you

lines.text: Gemini, the situationship is fun because nobody has to decide anything.
lines.caption: decide something

lines.text: Gemini, you want to be known, then change the story every time they get close.
lines.caption: same story twice

lines.text: Gemini, they can't keep up with plans you change every hour.
lines.caption: pick a plan

lines.text: Gemini, a person is not a podcast you can skip when it gets slow.
lines.caption: don't skip ahead

lines.text: Gemini, it's okay to want someone and still need space.
lines.caption: both are fine

lines.text: Gemini, ask them a question and don't change the subject.
lines.caption: stay on topic

lines.text: Gemini, steady can feel dull at first. Give it longer than a week.
lines.caption: longer than a week

lines.text: Gemini, twelve tabs open, and not one of them is your life.
lines.caption: close some tabs

lines.text: Gemini, boredom is not a crisis. Sit in it a little.
lines.caption: sit in it

lines.text: Gemini, both versions of you are real. Let them talk.
lines.caption: both are real

lines.text: Gemini, you know a little about everything. Pick one thing to know deeply.
lines.caption: go deep on one

lines.text: Gemini, the new hobby will feel old in two weeks. Keep it anyway.
lines.caption: keep the hobby

lines.text: Gemini, your mind is loud. That doesn't mean it's right.
lines.caption: loud not right

lines.text: Gemini, scrolling is not resting. Your brain knows the difference.
lines.caption: put the phone down

lines.text: Gemini, you say you'll start Monday. You've said that for a while.
lines.caption: which monday

lines.text: Gemini, the restless feeling is a question. Answer it, don't run from it.
lines.caption: answer it

lines.text: Gemini, you can change your mind. Just finish the thought first.
lines.caption: finish the thought

lines.text: Gemini, silence is not empty. It's where you finally hear yourself.
lines.caption: listen in

lines.text: Gemini, your attention is the rent you pay every app. Move out.
lines.caption: move out

lines.text: Gemini, explaining yourself to everyone is exhausting. Stop auditioning.
lines.caption: stop auditioning

lines.text: Gemini, you are not inconsistent. You are curious with no anchor.
lines.caption: find an anchor

lines.text: Gemini, a scattered day is fine. A scattered year is a choice.
lines.caption: gather it up

lines.text: Gemini, you argue both sides so well that you never do either.
lines.caption: pick a side

lines.text: Gemini, not every thought needs to be said out loud.
lines.caption: keep one inside

lines.text: Gemini, being clever won't hold you when you feel lonely.
lines.caption: clever is not company

lines.text: Gemini, you are everyone's fun friend and nobody's 3am call.
lines.caption: who do you call

lines.text: Gemini, focus is a muscle. Yours is just untrained, not broken.
lines.caption: not broken

lines.text: Gemini, the busy calendar is hiding a quiet question.
lines.caption: clear the calendar

lines.text: Gemini, more input won't help. Finishing something will.
lines.caption: finish something

lines.text: Gemini, your phone is not a person. Go talk to one.
lines.caption: go outside

lines.text: Gemini, depth is just curiosity that didn't leave.
lines.caption: curiosity that stayed

lines.text: Gemini, you keep reinventing yourself instead of returning to yourself.
lines.caption: come back home

lines.text: Gemini, the plan changes every week because you never chose one.
lines.caption: commit to one

lines.text: Gemini, write it down. Your mind moves too fast to remember it.
lines.caption: write it down

lines.text: Gemini, the twin in your head who doubts you is not the smart one.
lines.caption: ignore that twin

lines.text: Gemini, you can be two people. Just make sure both get some sleep.
lines.caption: both need sleep

lines.text: Gemini, one honest sentence beats a hundred clever ones.
lines.caption: one honest sentence

lines.text: Gemini, skip the clever opener. Say the true thing first and see who stays.
lines.caption: skip the opener

lines.text: Gemini, a good bio beats a good angle. Read their sky before their face.
lines.caption: bio over angle

lines.text: Gemini, ten open chats and no answers. Release the ones you'll never reply to.
lines.caption: mute the dead chats

lines.text: Gemini, if only you keep the conversation alive, it's a monologue.
lines.caption: it's a monologue

lines.text: Gemini, tell them you need room to wander before they fall for the one who stays.
lines.caption: say it early

lines.text: Gemini, you can start over as many times as you need. 11:11 comes every night.
lines.caption: every night again

lines.text: Gemini, both of your moods deserve company. Someone out there gets the pair.
lines.caption: someone gets both

lines.text: Gemini, your mind moves fast. Your Venus shows how your heart moves.
lines.caption: how your heart moves

lines.text: Gemini, tell yourself the honest version before you tell everyone the fun one.
lines.caption: the honest version

lines.text: Gemini, the idea you dropped last month can stay dropped. That's allowed.
lines.caption: let it stay dropped
